menu_options.browser_signin: Obtain a token with guided Google sign-in

browser_signin.title: Sign in to Google
browser_signin.description:
Use Chrome or Edge on a computer for these steps.

1. Open [Google sign-in]({signin_url}) in a separate tab.
2. Sign in to the same Google account you just linked, including any two-step verification.
3. Select **I agree** if Google asks. A loading screen that keeps spinning is expected; continue anyway.
4. Keep the Google tab open, return here, and select **Submit** for instructions to copy the temporary sign-in cookie.

Your Google password stays on Google's website. Home Assistant cannot read cookies from the Google tab automatically.

browser_token.title: Copy the temporary sign-in cookie
browser_token.description:
In the Google tab:

1. Press **F12** (or open the browser's Developer Tools).
2. Select **Application**; it may be under the **»** menu.
3. Under **Storage → Cookies**, select **{cookie_origin}**.
4. Find the cookie named **oauth_token** and copy only its **Value**. If it is missing, complete the Google sign-in and consent steps again.
5. Return to this trusted Home Assistant page, confirm the Google email, paste the value below, and select **Submit** promptly.

Home Assistant will generate a device ID, exchange this temporary cookie for a master token, and verify the account. It stores only the resulting credentials, not the temporary cookie. No terminal or separate helper is needed. Use your trusted HTTPS Home Assistant address when submitting credentials.

data_description.oauth_token: Copy the Value of oauth_token only. Do not paste your Google password, all cookies, or a HAR file.

error.invalid_auth: Google rejected the native credentials. Verify the email, master token and matching device ID.

error.wrong_account: Use native credentials for the same Google account you authorized.
error.invalid_browser_token: Google rejected the temporary cookie or native authorization. Repeat Google sign-in to obtain a fresh oauth_token value, then submit it promptly.
error.wrong_account_browser: These credentials do not match the linked Google account. Sign in to the correct account and copy a fresh oauth_token value.
error.browser_cannot_connect: Could not finish exchanging or verifying the token. The temporary cookie may have been consumed. Try again with a fresh oauth_token value.
